info.title: CloudPDF Admin API
info.description: Tenant-scoped admin surface of the CloudPDF document engine. Generated from the @cloudpdf/admin-api operation registry — do not edit by hand.

get.summary: License decision plus usage-reporting and meter snapshots for this deployment.
List documents in the tenant, newest first, cursor-paginated.

delete.summary: Delete a document and its stored artifacts.

post.summary: Finish an upload: verify the SHA-256 and promote the document to ready.

get.summary: Download the stored base PDF bytes.
Fetch the warmed dashboard-tile render for a document.

post.summary: Upload the PDF bytes through the origin instead of a presigned URL.
Begin an upload: create (or resume/dedupe) a pending document and issue upload access.
Revoke a token by jti; live sessions drop on their next heartbeat.
post.description: Mounted only when the deployment enables token revocation.

apiToken.description: The deployment's static root credential (CLOUDPDF_API_AUTH_TOKENS), valid on every surface.

tenantToken.description: Delegated tenant JWT, valid only under its own /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/ subtree — the path tenant must equal the token's tenant_id. Doc-scoped viewer tokens are rejected on every admin route.
